sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you take damage
sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Genjutsu (Auditory, Tactile), Barrier, Symphonic Branch

system.description:
You raise your Shinobi Instrument and release a surge of chakra through it causing it to vibrate like a tuning fork. These vibrations radiate a frequency that you take advantage of, forming a barrier to protect you from harm. This Barrier has 5d8 + 5 hit points and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. If the triggering damage would be greater than this barriers hit points, you take any remaining.

If your Barrier would have hit points remaining, all creatures within 10 feet of you feel the backlash, and they must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking psychic or force damage, equal to the barriers original hit points.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the barriers hit points by 1d8.
